gloss: point to revise; correction; thing to fix

definitions.gloss: point to revise; correction; item needing amendment; thing to fix
definitions.explanation: A specific item, detail, or aspect that needs to be corrected, changed, or improved. Commonly used in work, editing, and review contexts.

examples.japanese: {修正点|しゅうせいてん}をリストアップした。
examples.english: I listed the points that need correction.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}にいくつか{修正点|しゅうせいてん}がある。
examples.english: There are a few things to fix in the report.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}から{指摘|してき}された{修正点|しゅうせいてん}を{全|すべ}て{反映|はんえい}させた。
examples.english: I incorporated all the corrections pointed out by my boss.

notes:
Compound of {修正|しゅうせい} (correction, revision) + {点|てん} (point, item). A common word in business and editing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修正点|しゅうせいてん}を{指摘|してき}する: to point out corrections
- {修正点|しゅうせいてん}を{反映|はんえい}する: to incorporate corrections
- {修正点|しゅうせいてん}がある: there are things to fix
- {修正点|しゅうせいてん}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the corrections

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改善点|かいぜんてん}: points for improvement — focuses on making something better, not just fixing errors
- {問題点|もんだいてん}: problem areas — focuses on identifying issues
- {変更点|へんこうてん}: changes made — focuses on what was actually changed
